writeup: Sally Hansen's Vitamin E Nail & Cuticle Oil is a brush-on blend of vitamin E, apricot kernel, safflower and wheat germ oils with aloe for dry cuticles and brittle nails. Woot Sellout has the 0.45 oz bottle for $3.99, while Walmart charges $6.74, Target $6.89 and Ulta $7.49. Limit 3 per customer.
